instruction:
Fix `packages/excalidraw/tests/lasso.test.tsx` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. major (line 1927): Spec deviation that may hide a defect. change_plan says the bound-text case should use the wrapping lasso (40,40)-(260,260). The unit test uses (10,10)-(490,490) instead, and so does the integration test at line 2024. The label sits at x 70..230 and y 140..160, so (40,40)-(260,260) already encloses the container and its label with at least 30px to spare. The test was widened by 220px without a recorded reason, which suggests the planned lasso failed. If so, wrapTest or the bound-text segment check rejects a label that really is fully enclosed, and the tests now hide the bug. Confidence: medium. Not run, per review policy. — fix: Go back to the planned rectPath(40, 40, 260, 260) in both bound-text cases (lines ~1927 and ~2024). If that fails, fix the cause in lasso/utils.ts wrapTest (for example, label segments that don't match the position computeBoundTextPosition gives). Do not keep the widened lasso.
2. minor (line 2002): Redundant `API.setAppState({ boxSelectionMode: "contain" })` before the second stroke in 'wrap stroke over part of a group selects nothing'. The same happens at line 2023 in 'wrap stroke selects a container only with its bound text enclosed'. The mode is already "contain", so the reader may wrongly think the stroke resets it. — fix: Remove the second `API.setAppState({ boxSelectionMode: "contain" })` in both tests.

The file's current text is under Inputs, marked "current text"; your edits apply to exactly that text.
